title: Integration Tests, Service Calls and Observability
description: An integration test of the running application context, calling another service with RestClient using a configured base URL and timeouts, logging in Spring, and health checks with Spring Boot Actuator.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Standard S1-S13 and Fast FT1-FT8. This module covers Standard S11.
